name: SE Ranking
description: Data, SEO and Scraping: SEO platform with a Data API (keywords, backlinks, domain analytics, audits, AI visibility) and a Project API (rank tracking, project management).
access_notes: A single API key (Authorization: Token <key>, or apikey query param) is generated in the account dashboard and 'included in every SE Ranking plan'; the vendor states the API can be tested in the free trial account. Data API usage is billed in credits (plan allowance, PAYG packs from $50, or standalone annual API plans); Project API endpoints require a Business/Enterprise-tier subscription (403 'Subscription required' otherwise).
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP: centrally hosted remote server (seranking.com/mcp.html, 180+ tools, also a ChatGPT connector), with setup docs at seranking.com/api/integrations/mcp/. A previously cited open-source repo (github.com/seranking/seo-data-api-mcp-server) is no longer publicly available (GitHub 404; not in the seranking org's public repo list). No Composio toolkit found (composio.dev/toolkits/seranking and /se_ranking return 404).
uncertainty_notes: Webhook support was not determined from the pages reviewed. Sustained production use requires a paid subscription or credit purchases even though trial access is self-serve. The open-source MCP repo cited in an earlier draft has since been removed or made private on GitHub; the official MCP claim rests on the vendor-hosted remote server, which is live and documented.

evidence.note: One API key for both APIs, sent as 'Authorization: Token'; Data API billed in credits with PAYG from $50, Project API uses subscription limits
REST base https://api.seranking.com/v1 with Authorization header (recommended) or apikey query param; credit costs per endpoint
'API access is included in every SE Ranking plan... You can even test it in the free trial account'
Official hosted SE Ranking MCP server, 'centrally hosted and managed by SE Ranking', 180+ SEO/GEO tools
Official SE Ranking API documentation page for the MCP Server (setup instructions for connecting AI clients to the hosted vendor MCP)
